repos_data.description: Security sensor for realtime threat detection and protection

One command installs 670+ security tools on Debian/Ubuntu/Kali, Fedora, Arch, openSUSE and Termux. Its authorization-gated MCP server runs them in a disposable Kata Containers VM sandbox for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and other MCP clients. 872 agent skills for CTF, pentesting, bug bounty, DFIR and red/blue teams.

Zero-dependency Python CLI for targeted file collection - digital forensics, incident response, and selective backups. Cross-platform, with SHA-256 manifests, chain-of-custody logging, and checkpoint/resume for failing media.
Ask an AI agent about your Malcolm network traffic. MCP server for Zeek, Suricata, Arkime and NetBox data, read-only until you opt in to writes.
